# MeterRowData.NameColor field

Optional override for the name-text colour (e.g. a ready-check vote: blue=pending, green=ready, red=declined). When alpha is 0 (the default) the row uses the framework's standard name colour. The [`Dead`](./Dead.md) treatment still takes precedence.
